full_corpus.note: An earlier intermediate run (before the two extra bug fixes below were both applied) lost 2 variants (1 file: staging/sm/Proxy/global-receiver.js), diagnosed and fixed before this final gate: legacy_has_property's own prototype-chain walk (interp_legacy.rs) checked window_proxy_has at each step but not the new proxy_has, so a Proxy discovered by walking globalThis's prototype chain (Object.setPrototypeOf(globalThis, proxy)) for an unqualified identifier reference was silently skipped. The final numbers above are zero-loss.

method: linux-run.sh js-runtime, fixed base 76af29d4 (uncommitted Proxy edits on top). Baseline Test262 run at --ref 76af29d4 (no Proxy code). After-run against the working tree. Per-(path,variant) diff computed directly from both runs' full `records` arrays (test262.py's --compare only checks classification-hash stability between two runs of the SAME binary, not a semantic before/after diff, so the gained/lost counts here come from a custom flatten+diff over records, not --compare's own output). Repeat run of the identical after-binary against itself confirms classification_sha256 stability (no flakiness).
